correctness.rationale: For independent centroided volume-uniform points X,Y, expand D²=|X|²+|Y|²−2X·Y to obtain ED²=2m2 and ED⁴=2m4+2m2²+4tr(Σ²). Polar integration over the centroid-star-shaped body gives m2=d Eν(ρ²)/(d+2), m4=d Eν(ρ⁴)/(d+4); splitting radial second moment into square plus variance and trΣ² into m2²/d plus Frobenius anisotropy yields the displayed exact nonnegative defect coefficient (d+2)²/[2d(d+4)] for all d≥2. Constancy of radial function forces a ball for convex K; a cube has isotropic covariance and nonconstant radius, proving coefficient sharp. Planar annulus explicitly violates the convex/star-shaped bound. Independent exact rational box calculations d=2..7 verified the identity but do not prove all d.
